source: RPGClassics Suikoden III shrine — Army Units guide (Guides/armyunits.pdf); skill effect details cross-checked with the GameFAQs walkthrough (Guides/gamefaqs.rtf §3h).

skills.Control: Decides how many unit moves you get per turn — the highest Control on the field sets it (Control VIII = 7 moves).
skills.Fire Rune: Damages every unit in an adjacent area (each member loses ~1/5 HP).
skills.Heal: Fully heals one unit in the same area (Heal x2/x3 = uses per battle).
skills.Lightning Rune: Hits one enemy unit up to two areas away (each member loses ~1/3 HP).
skills.Quick Aid: Heals 25% of all lost HP to every member of the unit.
skills.Quicken: Grants an extra action (x1/x2 = uses per battle).
skills.Riding: The unit can travel up to three areas through friendly territory.
skills.Surprise: In a forest area the unit's attack is up 50%.
skills.Tactics: Raises attack coordination of the whole unit (I=5%, II=7%, III=10%).
skills.Valor: Raises offensive power of the whole unit (I=5%, II=10%, III=20%).
skills.Water Rune: Fully heals every member of one unit, up to one area away.
skills.Wind Rune: Offensive rune skill used by some leaders (e.g. Thomas's Wind Magic).

notes: A unit's HP in war battles are the members' own battle HP — level and equip characters (or edit them in the save editor) to strengthen your army.
The main character's True Fire / True Water Rune adds its own special ability on top of the skills above.
Non-Story-VIP characters can die permanently if their whole unit falls — press Story VIPs on the arrange screen to see who is at risk.
War-skill assignments are fixed in the game code, not in an editable data table — the list here is reference only.
